Name: Saraph
Summary: Named among the ancient men of Shelah's line who had dominion in Moab.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:22: Named among the ancient men of Shelah's line who had dominion in Moab.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Saraph stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
